citation_entries.sentence: From inside, we describe our worship as prayer, converse with God, spoken or silent.
Our teaching for baptism was katechesis, given step by step over a long time.
Our own record keeps its failures visible: our greatest teacher was driven out by his own bishop, not by pagans.
The school side of our record is well attested, and the community side is thinly attested.

text: From inside, we describe our worship as prayer, converse with God, spoken or silent. Our teaching for baptism was katechesis, given step by step over a long time. Our own record keeps its failures visible: our greatest teacher was driven out by his own bishop, not by pagans. The school side of our record is well attested, and the community side is thinly attested.
